design_gotchas.title: Extended -40°C to +125°C Upgrade Over LM393DR, But Wider Offset (7 mV / 15 mV Over Temp)
design_gotchas.detail: LM2903DR is pin-for-pin identical to commercial LM393DR (0°C to 70°C) and extends ambient rating to -40°C to +125°C, but its guaranteed input offset relaxes to 7 mV max at 25°C and 15 mV max over temperature (vs 5 mV / 9 mV on LM393DR) and typical total ICC rises to 0.8 mA.

design_gotchas.title: Identical SOIC-8 Pinout to Dual Op-Amps (LM358DR / LMV358IDR) — Never Swap With Op-Amps
design_gotchas.detail: LM2903DR shares the exact 8-pin SOIC layout of dual op-amps LM358DR and LMV358IDR, but has uncompensated open-collector outputs requiring external pull-up resistors. Populating it in a linear op-amp circuit causes oscillation and missing high-level drive.

design_gotchas.title: Negative Input Below -0.3 V Triggers Parasitic Substrate Conduction and Output Inversion
design_gotchas.detail: Common-mode input range is 0 V to VCC - 2.0 V over -40°C to 125°C (only one input must remain in range for a valid logic state). Driving either input below -0.3 V turns on parasitic substrate transistors, raising ICC and risking false output inversion.

design_gotchas.title: Non-B Legacy 30 V Limit vs Newer LM2903BIDR (36 V, 4 mV Over-Temp VIO)
design_gotchas.detail: Legacy LM2903DR is rated to 30 V operating (36 V abs max) with 1.3 µs typ response time. For 36 V industrial rails or tighter ±4 mV full-temperature offset, TI offers the drop-in next-generation LM2903BIDR (38 V abs max, 3.5 nA typ IB, 1.0 µs response).

typical_use_cases: Industrial and automotive-grade (-40°C to 125°C) drop-in upgrade for commercial LM393DR comparators
24 V factory automation, UPS, and motor-drive overcurrent/overvoltage fault supervisors
Wired-AND dual window comparators level-shifting 12 V/24 V sensors to 3.3 V/5 V logic
Wide-temperature relaxation oscillators, zero-crossing detectors, and Schmitt triggers
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments LM2903DR is the extended-temperature (-40°C to +125°C) industrial dual open-collector comparator in an 8-pin SOIC (D) package operating from 2 V to 30 V (36 V abs max). Pin-for-pin compatible with commercial LM393DR, it features ground-sensing PNP inputs, 1.3 µs typical response time (300 ns for TTL steps), 400 µA/ch typical quiescent current (0.8 mA total at 5 V), and 20 mA abs max output sink rating. Designers upgrading from LM393DR should budget for LM2903DR's wider 7 mV max (15 mV over temp) input offset and always provide external pull-up resistors.

audit_notes: Vision-verified SOIC-8 (D) Top View pinout on 300 DPI PNG page 3 (Figure 4-1 & Table 4-1): exact match with LM393DR.
Verified Non-B LM2903 ratings on 300 DPI PNG page 4 (36 V abs max, 2-30 V recommended, -40°C to 125°C TA, 150°C TJ) and page 5 (D package RθJA = 148.5 °C/W, RθJC(top) = 90.2 °C/W).

Verified Section 5.10 & 5.11 specs on 300 DPI PNG page 10: VIO = 7 mV max at 25°C (15 mV full range), IIB = -25 nA typ (25000 pA), ICC = 0.8 mA typ total (400 µA/ch), response time = 1.3 µs (1300 ns).
Ordering table PNG page 24 confirms LM2903DR Active, Production, SOIC (D) 8-pin, 2500 LARGE T&R, -40 to 125°C, marking LM2903.
